Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰 완수에 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 기운이 없어 보인다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks downhearted after failing to complete the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼の達成に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は元気がないようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来没精打彩。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來無精打采。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après l'échec de la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble abattu.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach dem Scheitern der Mission wirkt <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> niedergeschlagen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se ve desanimada tras fallar la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar em completar a quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece desanimada.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูหงอยเหงาหลังจากทำภารกิจไม่สำเร็จค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terlihat sedih setelah gagal menyelesaikan misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ ủ rũ sau khi thất bại trong nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: खोज पूरी करने में विफल रहने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> निराश दिख रहा है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Let's call it here and head back.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Lass uns hier Schluss machen und zurückgehen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Vamos parar por aqui e voltar.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: พอแค่นี้แล้วกลับกันเถอะค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Ayo kita akhiri di sini dan kembali.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hãy dừng ở đây và quay về thôi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: चलो इसे यहीं खत्म करते हैं और वापस चलते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Here, drink this and feel better.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: これを飲んで元気を出そう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tiens, bois ça et reprends des forces.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Hier, trink das und fühl dich besser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Aquí, bebe esto y siéntete mejor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Aqui, beba isso e se sinta melhor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดื่มนี่แล้วฮึบเข้าไว้นะคะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Minumlah ini dan rasakan lebih baik.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Nào, uống cái này đi cho khỏe lại.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: लो, इसे पियो और बेहतर महसूस करो।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to treat her failure as a stepping stone for growth.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は失敗を成長の糧にしようと決めた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>决定把失败作为成长的养分。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>決定把失敗作為成長的養分。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé de faire de son échec un tremplin pour sa croissance.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, ihr Scheitern als Sprungbrett für Wachstum zu nutzen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió tomar su fracaso como un trampolín para crecer.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu tratar seu fracasso como um degrau para o crescimento.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ตัดสินใจที่จะใช้ความล้มเหลวเป็นก้าวสำคัญในการเติบโตค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menjadikan kegagalannya sebagai batu loncatan untuk tumbuh.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định coi thất bại là bàn đạp để trưởng thành.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने अपनी विफलता को विकास का पायदान बनाने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s footsteps seemed unusually heavy as she walked away.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の帰る足取りが、なぜか重く見える。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>回去的脚步看起来有些沉重。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>回去的腳步看起來有些沉重。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Les pas de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblaient étrangement lourds en s'éloignant.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Schritte wirkten ungewöhnlich schwer, als sie wegging.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Los pasos de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecían inusualmente pesados mientras se alejaba.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Os passos de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> pareciam estranhamente pesados enquanto ela se afastava.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ดูเหมือนว่าฝีเท้าของ<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>จะหนักผิดปกติขณะที่เธอกำลังเดินจากไปค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Entah mengapa, langkah kaki <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terasa berat saat dia pergi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Bước chân của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ nặng nề bất thường khi cô ấy rời đi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के लौटते कदम किसी कारण से भारी लग रहे हैं।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retrouvé le sourire après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดูสดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยาค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tươi tỉnh hẳn lên sau khi nhận được thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हुआ।
